title: PUBLIC ROADMAP BOARD
description: The starter town now has a live roadmap board showing known issues, delayed features, weather-dependent promises, and one brutally honest sticky note from production.
consequence: The roadmap stops wearing a fake mustache.

title: NO DISGUISED INVITES
description: New players now see plain party invites, real friend referrals, and exact bonus terms instead of fake quest scrolls pretending to be urgent social destiny.
consequence: The invite button puts down the costume trunk.

title: FAKE FRIEND STARTING GRID
description: Opening races now fill empty slots with almost-familiar rival names, cheerful ghost avatars, and a suspicious prompt to invite the real version before the lights turn green.
consequence: The starting line starts forging handshakes.

title: WELCOME TRUST BADGES
description: The first menu now displays security seals, fairness medals, community promises, anti-scam ribbons, and a rotating assurance banner before explaining how to draw a card.
consequence: The welcome screen sweats through a blazer.
